protocols.name: Step 1: Lysis
protocols.description: Disruption of tissue in lysis buffer to release nucleic acids.

parameters.description: Volume of lysis buffer added to each sample

protocols.name: Step 2: Lysis
protocols.description: Further homogenization of lysate to ensure complete cell disruption.

protocols.name: Step 3: RNA Partitioning 1
protocols.description: Phase separation using phenol-chloroform to partition RNA into aqueous phase.

protocols.name: Step 4: RNA Partitioning 1
protocols.description: Repeat phenol-chloroform extraction to improve purity.

protocols.name: Step 5: RNA Partitioning 1
protocols.description: Final phenol-chloroform extraction before precipitation.

protocols.name: Step 6: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 1
protocols.description: Precipitate RNA from aqueous phase using isopropanol.

parameters.name: isopropanol_volume
parameters.description: Volume of isopropanol added for precipitation

protocols.name: Step 7: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 1
protocols.description: Centrifuge to pellet RNA after precipitation.

protocols.name: Step 8: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 1
protocols.description: Wash RNA pellet with 70% ethanol.

protocols.name: Step 9: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 1
protocols.description: Air‑dry the RNA pellet briefly.

protocols.name: Step 10: RNA Partitioning 2
protocols.description: Resuspend pellet in RNase‑free water and perform a second phenol extraction to remove residual contaminants.

protocols.name: Step 11: RNA Partitioning 2
protocols.description: Collect aqueous phase containing purified RNA.

protocols.name: Step 12: RNA Partitioning 2
protocols.description: Optional DNase treatment to remove DNA contamination.

protocols.name: Step 13: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Precipitate RNA after DNase treatment using ethanol.

parameters.name: salt_concentration
parameters.description: Final concentration of NaCl or similar salt

protocols.name: Step 14: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Centrifuge to pellet RNA.

protocols.name: Step 15: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Wash RNA pellet with 70% ethanol.

protocols.name: Step 16: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Air‑dry and resuspend final RNA pellet.

parameters.name: resuspension_volume
parameters.description: RNase‑free water used for final resuspension

protocols.name: Step 17: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 3
protocols.description: Quality check of RNA by spectrophotometry.

protocols.name: Step 18: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 3
protocols.description: Assess RNA integrity on agarose gel.

protocols.name: Step 19: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 3
protocols.description: Store RNA at -80°C for long‑term preservation.

protocols.name: Step 20: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 3
protocols.description: Document sample metadata and experimental conditions.

protocols.name: Step 21: Resuspension and Storage
protocols.description: Final resuspension of RNA in RNase‑free water and aliquoting.

protocols.name: Step 22: Lysis
protocols.description: Optional repeat lysis for low‑yield samples.

protocols.name: Step 23: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Second round precipitation to concentrate RNA after repeat lysis.

protocols.name: Step 1: Sample collection
protocols.description: Collect homogenized bioassessment sample containing algae.

protocols.name: Step 2: Sample collection
protocols.description: Transfer collected algae suspension to a 47 mm Whatman/Swinnex filter holder or funnel.

parameters.name: Filter holder size
parameters.description: Diameter of the filter holder used

protocols.name: Step 3: Filtering
protocols.description: Filter algae through a 0.45 µm cellulose nitrate filter to capture cells.

parameters.name: Filter pore size
parameters.description: Pore size of the cellulose nitrate filter

protocols.name: Step 4: Filtering
protocols.description: Rinse filter with sterile deionized water to remove residual matrix.

parameters.name: Rinse volume
parameters.description: Volume of sterile deionized water used for rinsing (not specified)

protocols.name: Step 5: After Filtering
protocols.description: Place filter into a screw‑cap tube containing preservation solution.

parameters.name: Preservation solution
parameters.description: Solution used to preserve DNA (composition not specified)

protocols.name: Step 6: After Filtering
protocols.description: Label tube with sample ID and metadata.

protocols.name: Step 7: After Filtering
protocols.description: Store labeled tubes at -20 °C (or -80 °C) for up to six months.

parameters.name: Maximum storage time
parameters.description: Maximum duration samples can be stored before DNA extraction

protocols.name: Step 8: Collecting a Field Blank
protocols.description: Filter deionized water through the same apparatus to generate a blank control.

parameters.name: Blank filter pore size
parameters.description: Same pore size as sample filters

protocols.name: Step 9: Sample Metadata
protocols.description: Record metadata for each sample and blank (date, location, filter type, preservation details).

parameters.name: Metadata fields
parameters.description: Date, location, filter type, preservation solution, storage temperature

protocols.description: Clarify the lysate by low‑speed centrifugation and concentrate viral particles.

protocols.name: Viral clarification and concentration - step 2
protocols.description: Further concentrate the clarified virus by ultracentrifugation.

protocols.name: Viral purification using linear sucrose gradient - step 1
protocols.description: Layer the concentrated virus onto a linear sucrose gradient and centrifuge to separate particles.

parameters.name: Sucrose gradient range
parameters.description: Percent sucrose range for the gradient

protocols.name: Viral purification using linear sucrose gradient - step 2
protocols.description: Collect the virus‑containing fraction from the sucrose gradient.

protocols.name: Viral purification using linear sucrose gradient - step 3
protocols.description: Dialyze the collected fraction to remove sucrose.

protocols.name: Extraction of DNA
protocols.description: Extract viral DNA from the purified virus using a standard phenol‑chloroform method.

parameters.name: Phenol‑chloroform ratio
parameters.description: Ratio of phenol to chloroform used

protocols.name: QuBit quantification using Qubit 4 fluorimeter
protocols.description: Quantify the extracted DNA concentration with a Qubit 4 fluorometer.
